newsitem.title: UK: FORECAST-Vickers gets a chance to impress.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Vickers gets a chance to impress.

text.p: After a sticky start to the year and prolonged sideways slide by its shares, analysts suspect tanks-to-Rolls-Royce cars maker Vickers Plc could impress the market when it reports interim results on Thursday.
"We expect relatively solid performance, relatively pleasing profits and perhaps numbers near the top of the range," said one analyst, who admitted his published forecast was more bearish.

Brokers' estimates for pretax profits range from a sluggish 29 million stg to a bullish 41 million stg, versus 27 million a year ago, and all the analysts polled by Reuters saw a dividend hike -- most opting for 2.8p per share, up from 2.4p.
Another analyst said that the prospect of a pretax profit firmly over 30 million stg, and above the consensus average of 32.4 million, might well provide a boost the shares sorely need.

"The shares certainly need something this year, and these figures might be it. Hopefully, the company will also have something concretely positive to say after the rather mixed signals it has given had so far," the analyst added.
Another analyst said the shares would probably struggle to advance if the results are humdrum, especially as the market is seen nervous ahead of U.S. monthly jobs data next Friday.
Vickers shed 3p on Friday to end the week at 269-1/2p.
